```{devoirs_choices input_and_output_scaling_7_one_choices}
- 'Choosing labels and intervals on both axes so pure-number coordinates correspond to quantities.':
    correct: true
    feedback: |
      Correct.
- 'Replacing all quantities in a model with unitless numbers and discarding their units.':
    correct: false
    feedback: |
      Scaling allows quantities and their units to be represented on the axes; it does not discard what the quantities mean.
- 'A procedure for measuring whether a system''s dimensions are interconnected.':
    correct: false
    feedback: |
      That concerns describing a system. Input and output scaling adapts a core function's numerical axes to quantities.
- 'Reversing a function so that its quantity output becomes its input and its input becomes the output.':
    correct: false
    feedback: |
      Scaling maps quantities to and from the existing input-output axes; it does not reverse their roles.
```
